The '''Asworal Everglades''' were a region of [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] and [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] on the [[Naboo/Legends|Nabooian]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. It bordered the [[Mudflats]] and the [[Narmle Bog]].<ref name="SWG" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Asworal Everglades are one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
